fa765f8b1c5c4b84.title: Intravenous methylphenidate for acute traumatic disorders of consciousness: A phase 1 dose-finding and target engagement study
digest: Methods: We performed an open-label, Phase 1 safety and dose-finding study of intravenous methylphenidate (IV MPH) in ICU patients with acute disorders of consciousness (DoC) caused by severe TBI.

Findings: Between August 24, 2020, and April 1, 2024, we screened 488 ICU patients with TBI and enrolled 9 males (age 23-79 years) with acute traumatic DoC: coma (n=3), vegetative state/unresponsive wakefulness syndrome (n=3), and minimally conscious state (n=3).

e9bf4561a5df4284.title: Transfected plasmids have reduced expression in cells deficient in SEPTIN 9 or ESCRT proteins
digest: Transfection of cells with DNA plasmids typically involves the uptake of lipoparticles by endocytosis, followed by the inefficient escape of these particles from endosomes into the cytoplasm.
We found that the expression of transfected plasmids was reduced in cells depleted of either SEPTIN 9 or proteins in the endosomal sorting complexes required for transport (ESCRT) pathway.
The reduction in plasmid expression could not be fully explained by effects on endocytosis.
